meaning: readback of existing measured JSON, not new model runs

data.protocol: 5 outer cov80 folds, inner cov80 validation; 3 training seeds; no scan data used; exploratory development benchmark, not untouched external validation

data.checks: PASS: counts, finite predictions, PAP reproduction, disjoint outer groups, per-seed recalculation, all 45 checkpoint splits and held-out predictions

data.hyperparameters: author published: Adam lr 1e-4, batch 512, d_model 128, 4 layers, 8 heads, ff 256, dropout 0.1
data.target: absolute PSI of the sequence, z scored on outer train; cell score is pred(mutant) minus pred(wild type)

data.success_criterion: positive paired delta against ridge in all three seeds AND cluster bootstrap CI excluding zero AND the same against frozen DeltaPAP

thresholds.core_excluded_by: danh sách tường minh, không theo tần suất

definitions.note: PSI thang 1-6, thap = bi phan huy nhanh
